chapters.title: “Hello, Everybody, and Welcome to Another Exciting Hour of Wrestling. My Name Is Jim Ross and I’ll Be Your Host…”
“Everywhere I Go… People Are Talking about Mid-South Wrestling.”
“Jerry, This One Started Off like a House Afire, Just like We Knew It Would.”
“Reed Is Walking Tall and He’s Whipping Them All!”
“Both Men Fatigued. They’ve Beaten Each Other Senseless in This Confrontation for the Heavyweight Championship of the World.”
“They’re Trying to Put His Eye Out! They’re Sticking That Spike Right in His Eye!”
“You Can Hear Them Breathing. You Can Hear Them Exerting Every Ounce of Energy in Their Athletic Bodies, as a Battle for the World’s Title in the NWA Is on the Line…”
“And He Says Hit Me Again! And Hit Me Again! And the Champion Is Doing It.”
“I Don’t Know the Condition of Abdullah The Butcher. And I Don’t See Anyone Rushing to Give Him Mouth-to-Mouth Resuscitation.”
“He’s Now on Top of the Mountain!”
“It’s Good to Be Back and Feel That Electricity in the Air!”
“Some Folks Will Do a Lot of Things with Their Fifteen Minutes of Fame!”
“Now, There’s Going to Be The Man Right There.”
“He’s on One Leg, He’s Lost All Kinds of Blood, but He’s Refusing Any Kind of Help. He’s Going to Walk Out of Here on His Own.”
“They’re Cuffing Austin. He Has Let the Police Put the Handcuffs on Him. Austin Is Going Directly to Jail!”
“You Talk about Controversy. This Crowd Is Livid.”
“Well, Look Who’s Back… a New Day Is Dawning.”
“As God Is My Witness, He’s Broken in Half!”
“Chyna Has Made History! Chyna, the First Woman to Become the Intercontinental Champion!”
“How Do You Learn to Fall off a Damn Ladder?”
“The Million Dollar Princess Has Become a Dairy Queen!”
“Climb the Ladder, Kid! Make Yourself Famous!”
“The Pride of Edna, Raised a Country Boy Down in Texas, Grew up Wanting to Be Here, Wanting to Do This. This Is His Life; This Is His Destiny.”

“I’d Like to See Bischoff Get Every Bone in His Body Broken and Then Be Left in a Bloody Heap. Then I’d Like to See Kane Walk outside the Building and Get His Seven-Foot Ass Run over by a Damn Truck.”
“Two Miles of Steel Chain, and Triple H’s Blood Is a Part of It.”
“Lita Might Have a Broken Neck, but She’s By-God Still Competing! She’s Still in the Hunt Here. That’s How Bad She Wants to Win It!”
“The Three-Hundred-and-Seventeen Pounder Is Hungry. He Is Thirsty for the World’s Heavyweight Championship.”
“I Think Vince Looks Forward to Going to Hell. He Can Take Over. Satan Would Be out of Business.”
“My Break Came in 1993 When I Married My Wife, Jan.”
“Wait a Minute. What the Hell?! It’s John Cena!”
“Mayweather Has Taken It to the Street!”
“I Love Being Back on Raw. I Watch You Every Week.”
“It Is the End of an Era, and We Are All Going to Be Part of It!”
“Bottom Line, Gentlemen, He’s Got the Old Man’s Blood in Him. ‘The American Dream’ Lives through the Heart and Soul of His Son…”
“It’s Wednesday… and You Know What That Means.”
“Game Face On, Ready for Battle. There’s Never Been Anyone Else like This Man… It’s Clobberin’ Time!”
“Something Is Going to Implode—I Mean, Really Implode—Here Tonight. The Intensity Is Too Much.”
“God, I Love This Drama! This Energy!”
“Wouldn’t Want to Be Anywhere Else in the Entire World than Right Here!”
